changelog:
v3.7.2 — EPG Fallback Fix

When your provider's EPG feed is down or empty, the app now gracefully falls back to inferred program info instead of showing blank cards and a "No EPG data available" panel.

• Channel cards show italicized rule-based text under each focused channel — e.g. "Prime Time News", "Live Sports", "Morning Cartoons" based on the channel's name and time of day
• Preview schedule panel now shows "Now: <inferred program> — (schedule unavailable from provider)" instead of a blank empty-state
• Pattern cache kicks in if you've watched that channel at that time before

Under the hood
• Fixed a latent StateFlow dedup bug that silently swallowed empty-to-empty EPG emissions, which prevented the fallback from ever firing on providers returning empty listings for every channel
• EPG fetch failures and empty responses now log to the diagnostic file. Next time someone reports "no EPG", Send Debug Log will show a timestamped EPG_EMPTY event with the stream ID — no guessing required.
